exposure: placental microbial profiles (abundance, diversity, specific species like Ralstonia insidiosa and Streptococcus agalactiae)
placental sites (basal plate, fetal membranes, placental villous)
cohort: The study compared microbial profiles in pregnant women delivering either preterm (<37 weeks) or at term (>37 weeks).
finding: The placenta hosts its own microbiome, which varies temporally and spatially, showing distinct profiles between term and preterm samples, with some bacteria notably enriched in preterm cases.
mod_finding: No alteration in bacterial communities was found based on delivery mode across all samples.
